description: This Java source file defines the class OpenmrsObjectSaveHandler, which implements the SaveHandler interface for OpenmrsObject instances. Its primary responsibilities include assigning a UUID to objects lacking one upon save and sanitizing string properties by trimming whitespace and setting empty strings to null, based on specific annotations. The class is used within the OpenMRS platform to enforce data consistency when saving OpenmrsObject instances.

classes.name: OpenmrsObjectSaveHandler
classes.description: A handler class for OpenmrsObject instances that assigns UUIDs and sanitizes string properties on save.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles the save operation for an OpenmrsObject, assigning a UUID if missing, and trimming or nullifying string properties based on annotations.
